newsitem.title: SPAIN: MOTORCYCLING-CRIVILLE BEATS DOOHAN TO WIN SPANISH GP.
newsitem.headline: MOTORCYCLING-CRIVILLE BEATS DOOHAN TO WIN SPANISH GP.

text.p: Alex Criville delighted the home fans by dominating the 500 cc Spanish motorcycle Grand Prix on Sunday.
Criville led from start to finish, to beat teammate and world champion Michael Doohan, who finished nearly six seconds back after snatching second from another Honda man, Tadayuki Okada.
The win gave some compensation to Criville, who had crashed while in sight of the finish line in last year's race after slowing to avoid fans who had spilled onto the track to celebrate his victory.
Italian teenager Valentino Rossi came back from a poor start to snatch a last-gasp victory in an exciting 125 cc race, while Germany's Ralf Waldmann powered to a comfortable win in the 250 cc event.
